name: Oatmeal with Yogurt & Spinach
instructions: Cook oats according to package directions.
Microwave frozen spinach for 1-2 minutes, drain excess water.
Top oatmeal with Greek yogurt and warm spinach.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper if desired.

name: Egg Scramble with Zucchini & Spinach
instructions: Dice zucchini into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté zucchini for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add frozen spinach and cook until thawed and warm.
Push veggies to the side, crack in eggs and scramble.
Mix everything together, season with salt and pepper.

name: Overnight Oats with Greek Yogurt
instructions: Combine oats and Greek yogurt in a jar or container.
Add a splash of water or milk to loosen.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir and eat cold or microwave to warm.

name: Egg Scramble with Sweet Potato
instructions: Peel and dice sweet potato into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook sweet potato cubes for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender.
Push potatoes to the side, crack in eggs and scramble.
Mix together, season with salt and pepper.

name: Veggie Omelet
instructions: Thaw and drain frozen spinach.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and minced garlic for 2 minutes.
Add spinach and cook 1 minute more.
Beat eggs, pour over vegetables, and cook until edges set.
Fold omelet in half, cook 1 more minute, and serve.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash banana in a bowl until smooth.
Blend oats into a fine flour using a blender.
Mix oat flour with eggs and mashed banana until a thick batter forms.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat.
Pour small rounds of batter and cook 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve warm.

name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
instructions: Peel and dice sweet potato into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sweet potato and diced onion, cook 8-10 minutes until golden and tender.
Add minced garlic, cook 1 minute more.
Make two wells, crack an egg into each, cover and cook until eggs set.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Spread peanut butter evenly on each slice.
Top with sliced banana.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Bacon & Egg on Toast
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, set aside on a paper towel.
Fry eggs in the bacon grease over medium heat to your liking.
Toast bread.
Stack bacon and eggs on toast. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Sausage & Pepper Egg Scramble
instructions: Slice sausage into rounds and dice bell pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook sausage 3-4 minutes until browned.
Add bell pepper, cook 2 minutes more.
Beat eggs, pour into skillet, and scramble with sausage and peppers.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Cottage Cheese & Tomato Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Spread cottage cheese on each slice.
Top with fresh tomato slices.
Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Scramble eggs in a lightly oiled skillet.
Warm black beans in the microwave or a small pot.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet for 30 seconds each side.
Layer eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa in the center of the tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll into a burrito.

name: Yogurt Bowl with Oats & Honey
instructions: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with oats, sliced banana, and a drizzle of honey.
Eat immediately or let sit 5 minutes to soften the oats.

name: Mushroom & Cheese Omelet
instructions: Slice mushrooms thinly.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté mushrooms 3-4 minutes until golden.
Beat eggs and pour over mushrooms.
Cook until edges set, sprinkle cheese on one half.
Fold omelet, cook 1 more minute until cheese melts.

name: Potato & Egg Breakfast Hash
instructions: Dice potato into small cubes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook potato and onion 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and crispy.
Sprinkle with paprika, make wells, crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs are set. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Cereal with Milk & Banana
instructions: Pour cereal into a bowl.
Add milk.
Top with sliced banana and eat immediately.

name: Peanut Butter Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats according to package directions.
Stir in peanut butter until melted and combined.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

name: Avocado & Egg Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon, salt, and pepper.
Fry egg to your liking.
Spread avocado on toast and top with the fried egg.

name: Egg & Cheese Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Scramble eggs in a lightly oiled skillet.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet 30 seconds each side.
Place eggs and cheese in the center of the tortilla.
Add hot sauce, fold and roll into a wrap.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats according to package directions.
While oats cook, dice apple into small pieces.
Melt butter in a small pan, sauté apple pieces 2-3 minutes until soft.
Top oatmeal with warm apples and a drizzle of honey.

name: Cream Cheese & Cucumber Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Spread cream cheese evenly on each slice.
Layer cucumber slices on top.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon, salt, and pepper.

name: Tuna & Chickpea Salad
instructions: Drain tuna and chickpeas.
Grate or finely dice carrots.
Combine tuna, chickpeas, and carrots in a bowl.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top and drizzle with olive oil.
Toss to combine, season with salt and pepper.

name: Rice & Black Bean Bowl
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Drain and rinse black beans.
Shred cabbage finely.
Sauté diced onion and garlic until soft, add beans and warm through.
Serve beans over rice, topped with shredded cabbage.

name: Black Bean Soup
instructions: Sauté diced onion and garlic in a pot until softened.
Add drained black beans and canned tomatoes.
Add 1 cup water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook 15 minutes until flavors meld.
Mash some beans against the side of the pot to thicken.
Season with salt, pepper, and cumin if desired.

name: Tuna & Chickpea Bowl with Cabbage
instructions: Drain tuna and chickpeas.
Shred cabbage finely.
Toss tuna, chickpeas, and cabbage together in a bowl.
Season with salt, pepper, and a splash of vinegar or lemon if available.

name: Cabbage Stir-Fry with Fried Egg
instructions: Shred cabbage and slice carrots thinly.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Add cabbage, carrots, and frozen broccoli. Stir-fry 5-6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Push veggies to the side, fry egg sunny-side up or scrambled.
Serve veggies topped with the egg. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Leftover Fridge Bowl
instructions: Reheat leftover brown rice in the microwave.
Steam or microwave frozen broccoli until tender.
Combine in a bowl.
Season with salt, pepper, and a drizzle of soy sauce or olive oil.

name: Chickpea & Spinach Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Heat olive oil in a skillet, add drained chickpeas and cook 3-4 minutes.
Add frozen spinach and cook until warmed through.
Serve over rice with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Deli Turkey & Cheddar Wrap
instructions: Lay tortilla flat and spread mustard across the center.
Layer turkey slices, cheese, and lettuce leaves.
Roll tightly into a wrap.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, carrots, and celery in a pot with a little oil for 3-4 minutes.
Add lentils, broth, cumin, and 1 cup water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Mash drained pinto beans with a fork.
Spread beans on one tortilla, top with cheese and second tortilla.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Chicken Salad Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Shred cooked chicken breast.
Mix with mayo, diced celery, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spoon chicken salad into lettuce leaves.
Wrap and eat.

name: Loaded Veggie Ramen
instructions: Cook ramen noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes (use half the seasoning packet or just soy sauce).
Add frozen peas in the last minute of cooking.
Crack egg into the pot and stir to create egg ribbons.
Serve in a bowl topped with sliced green onion.

name: Open-Face Tuna Melt
instructions: Mix drained tuna with mayo, salt, and pepper.
Spread tuna mixture on bread slices.
Top each with a slice of cheddar.
Broil in the oven 3-4 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.

name: Veggie Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions, drain, and rinse with cold water.
Dice cucumber and tomato.
Toss pasta with vegetables, olive oil, lemon juice, and Italian seasoning.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve cold or room temperature.

name: Peanut Butter & Apple Wrap
instructions: Spread peanut butter across the tortilla.
Arrange apple slices in a row across the center.
Drizzle with honey.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool, and peel.
Mash eggs with a fork, mix in mayo and mustard.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve on bread with lettuce.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
instructions: Season diced chicken with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat 5-6 minutes.
Serve over rice with black beans, salsa, sour cream, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Tofu & Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Press tofu and cut into cubes.
Heat oil in a skillet over high heat, add tofu and cook until golden on all sides.
Add frozen mixed vegetables and stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Corn & Black Bean Salad
instructions: Drain and rinse corn and black beans.
Dice tomato and chop cilantro.
Toss everything with lime juice and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve cold.

name: Avocado Tuna Bowl
instructions: Drain tuna and place over cooked rice.
Add diced avocado and sliced cucumber.
Drizzle with soy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup
instructions: Butter bread on one side, place cheese between slices.
Cook in a skillet over medium heat 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
In a small pot, combine tomato sauce and broth, heat until simmering.
Season soup with salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar if desired.
Serve grilled cheese with soup for dipping.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato & Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut sweet potato into wedges, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken thighs and sweet potato on a sheet pan.
Bake 25 minutes, then add frozen broccoli to the pan.
Bake 10-15 more minutes until chicken reaches 165°F.
Serve together.

name: Turkey & Chickpea Tomato Skillet
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Brown ground turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it apart.
Add diced onion and garlic, cook 2 minutes.
Stir in canned tomatoes and drained chickpeas.
Simmer 10-15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Serve over brown rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Broccoli & Carrots
instructions: Cook brown rice and let cool (day-old rice works best).
Dice carrots small. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat.
Add carrots and frozen broccoli, stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Push veggies aside, scramble eggs in the open space.
Add rice, toss everything together and cook 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Shredded Chicken over Rice with Broccoli
instructions: Boil or poach chicken thighs in salted water for 15-20 minutes until cooked through.
Shred chicken with two forks.
Cook brown rice according to package directions.
Steam frozen broccoli until tender.
Serve shredded chicken over rice with broccoli on the side.

name: Turkey Stuffed Zucchini Boats
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Halve zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the centers.
Brown ground turkey with diced onion and garlic.
Stir in canned tomatoes and the chopped zucchini centers.
Fill zucchini halves with the turkey mixture.
Bake 20-25 minutes until zucchini is tender.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cube sweet potato, toss with a little oil, and roast 20-25 minutes.
Warm black beans in a small pot with diced onion and garlic.
Serve roasted sweet potato topped with seasoned black beans.
Dollop Greek yogurt on top.

name: Chicken & Veggie Soup
instructions: Dice chicken thighs into bite-size pieces.
Sauté diced onion and garlic in a pot until softened.
Add chicken and brown for 3-4 minutes.
Add diced carrots, zucchini, canned tomatoes, and broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs if desired.

name: Beef Taco Bowl
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet, drain excess fat.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water, simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over rice with black beans, cheese, and salsa.

name: Turkey Pasta with Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Brown turkey in a skillet with onion and garlic.
Add tomato sauce and Italian seasoning, simmer 10 minutes.
Toss with drained pasta and serve.

name: Pan-Seared Pork Chop with Potato & Green Beans
instructions: Season pork chop with salt and pepper.
Boil cubed potato until fork-tender, about 12 minutes.
Sear pork chop in butter 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through.
Add garlic to the pan in the last minute.
Warm green beans and serve alongside pork and potato.

name: Baked Salmon with Rice & Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place salmon on a lined sheet pan, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper.
Bake 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily.
Steam broccoli and serve with rice.

name: Shrimp Stir-Fry with Vegetables
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add shrimp and grated ginger, cook 2 minutes per side.
Add frozen mixed vegetables, stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Beef & Bean Chili
instructions: Brown ground beef with diced onion in a large pot.
Drain excess fat.
Add garlic, chili powder, and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Chicken Fajita Bowl
instructions: Slice chicken, bell pepper, and onion into strips.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat.
Cook chicken strips 5-6 minutes until browned.
Add peppers and onion, cook 3-4 minutes more.
Squeeze lime over everything.
Serve over rice.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a pot.
Add cubed sweet potato, cumin, and 1/2 cup water. Cook 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes, tofu cubes, and peas. Simmer 10 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve over rice.

name: Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Brown beef with onion and garlic in a skillet.
Add tomato sauce and Italian seasoning, simmer 10 minutes.
Serve sauce over drained pasta.

name: Chicken & Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Shred cooked chicken.
Layer chicken and cheese between two tortillas.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Lentil & Spinach Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add lentils, cumin, tomatoes, and 1 cup water.
Simmer 20 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in frozen spinach and cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over rice.

name: Beef & Pepper Stir-Fry
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or skillet over high heat.
Brown beef, breaking it into pieces, 4-5 minutes.
Add sliced bell pepper and broccoli, stir-fry 3-4 minutes.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

name: Bean & Corn Tacos
instructions: Warm beans and corn together in a small pot or skillet.
Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with bean-corn mixture, cheese, and salsa.

name: Bacon & Potato Soup
instructions: Cook chopped bacon in a pot until crispy, set aside.
Sauté onion in the bacon grease 2-3 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and broth, bring to a boil.
Simmer 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Mash some potatoes to thicken. Stir in sour cream.
Serve topped with bacon bits and a sprinkle of cheese.

name: Savory Oat Bowl with Egg & Soy
instructions: Cook oats with water and a pinch of salt.
Fry egg sunny-side up in a lightly oiled pan.
Top oats with fried egg, a drizzle of soy sauce, and sliced green onion.

name: Bacon & Cheddar Scramble
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crispy, crumble and set aside.
Beat eggs and scramble in the same pan over medium heat.
When almost set, stir in cheddar and crumbled bacon.
Season with pepper and serve.

name: Sweet Potato Toast with Peanut Butter
instructions: Slice sweet potato into 1/4 inch thick planks.
Toast in a toaster or oven at 400°F for 10 minutes until tender.
Spread peanut butter on top, add banana slices and drizzle with honey.

name: Veggie Egg Muffin Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a muffin tin.
Beat eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Divide diced pepper, thawed spinach, and cheese among 4 muffin cups.
Pour egg mixture over the veggies.
Bake 18-20 minutes until set and golden.

name: Cornbread with Sausage & Honey
instructions: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and bake.
Cook sausage links in a skillet until browned.
Serve warm cornbread with butter, honey drizzle, and sausage on the side.

name: Apple & Sausage Breakfast Hash
instructions: Dice sausage, potato, and apple into small cubes.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook potato 5-6 minutes until starting to brown.
Add sausage and apple, cook 5 more minutes until everything is golden.
Season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of cinnamon.

name: Orange Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Peel and segment the orange.
Layer yogurt, oats, and orange segments in a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Cheesy Tomato Toast
instructions: Top bread with tomato slices and mozzarella.
Broil 3-4 minutes until cheese melts and bubbles.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend frozen banana, peanut butter, and milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with oats and serve immediately.

name: Spanish-Style Egg & Potato Tortilla
instructions: Thinly slice potato and onion.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet, cook potato and onion 8-10 minutes until soft.
Beat eggs with salt, pour over potatoes.
Cook on low 5 minutes until bottom sets.
Flip onto a plate and slide back in to cook the other side 3 minutes.
Slice into wedges.

name: Jalapeño Egg & Bean Wrap
instructions: Scramble eggs in a lightly oiled skillet.
Warm mashed pinto beans.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet.
Layer beans, scrambled eggs, and jalapeño slices in the tortilla.
Add hot sauce, fold and roll.

name: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, eggs, and oats until smooth.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Pour small rounds of batter and cook 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with honey or fruit if desired.

name: Sautéed Mushroom & Garlic Toast
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook 4-5 minutes until golden.
Add minced garlic, cook 1 more minute.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toast bread and pile mushrooms on top.

name: Carrot Cake Oatmeal
instructions: Cook oats with milk and grated carrot until thick and creamy.
Stir in honey and a pinch of cinnamon.
Top with a dollop of cream cheese and serve warm.

name: Mediterranean Tuna Wrap
instructions: Mix drained tuna with diced cucumber, tomato, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon into tortilla and roll into a wrap.

name: Pork Fried Rice
instructions: Dice pork into small pieces and cook in oil over high heat 3-4 minutes.
Push pork aside, scramble egg in the pan.
Add cooked rice and frozen peas, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, toss everything together and serve.

name: Black Bean & Avocado Quesadilla
instructions: Spread mashed black beans on one tortilla.
Top with avocado slices and cheese, place second tortilla on top.
Cook in a dry skillet 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Squeeze lime over the top, cut into wedges.

name: Chicken Ramen Bowl
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package. Discard seasoning packet.
Sauté sliced chicken in a skillet 4-5 minutes.
Add ginger and broccoli, cook 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce and drained noodles, toss together and serve.

name: Cottage Cheese & Veggie Power Bowl
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with diced cucumber and tomato.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt, pepper, and everything bagel seasoning if desired.

name: Salmon & Rice Salad Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear salmon fillet 3-4 minutes per side.
Flake salmon over a bed of chopped lettuce.
Add cooked rice and sliced cucumber.
Drizzle with soy sauce and serve.

name: Lentil & Tomato Wrap
instructions: Cook lentils in water with cumin for 15 minutes until tender. Drain.
Warm tortilla in a dry skillet.
Layer lettuce, lentils, and diced tomato in the tortilla.
Season with salt and pepper, roll up.

name: Shrimp & Avocado Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook shrimp in a skillet over high heat 2 minutes per side.
Serve over rice with sliced avocado.
Squeeze lime over everything and add hot sauce.

name: Mushroom & Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.
Sauté mushrooms and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve mushroom mixture over quinoa. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Turkey, Apple & Cheddar Wrap
instructions: Spread mustard on tortilla.
Layer turkey, cheddar, and thin apple slices.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

name: Quick Bean Chili with Cornbread
instructions: Combine beans, tomatoes, and chili powder in a pot. Simmer 15 minutes.
Prepare cornbread according to package directions and bake.
Serve chili with a slice of warm cornbread.

name: Egg Drop Soup with Rice
instructions: Bring broth to a gentle boil.
Beat eggs. Slowly drizzle into the broth while stirring to create ribbons.
Add soy sauce and cooked rice.
Serve topped with sliced green onion.

name: Caprese Toast
instructions: Toast bread until golden.
Layer mozzarella and tomato slices on top.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper.

name: Bacon & Cabbage Skillet
instructions: Cook chopped bacon until crispy, set aside.
In the bacon grease, cook diced potato 6-8 minutes until golden.
Add onion and cabbage, cook 4-5 minutes until cabbage wilts.
Toss bacon back in, season with salt and pepper.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs with Rice
instructions: Mix honey, soy sauce, and minced garlic.
Sear chicken thighs in a hot skillet 5 minutes per side.
Pour sauce over chicken, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes until glazed.
Serve over rice.

name: Pork & Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Slice pork thin against the grain.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat, cook pork 3-4 minutes.
Add broccoli and ginger, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, toss, and serve over rice.

name: Salmon & Potato Sheet Pan Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss cubed potatoes and green beans with olive oil on a sheet pan.
Roast 15 minutes, then add salmon fillet.
Squeeze lemon over salmon, season everything with salt and pepper.
Bake 12-15 more minutes until salmon flakes.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Brown turkey in a skillet, drain fat.
Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water, simmer 5 minutes.
Spoon turkey into lettuce cups.
Top with diced tomato and sour cream.

name: Chickpea & Potato Curry
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add cubed potato and cumin, cook 2 minutes.
Add chickpeas, tomatoes, and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer 18-20 minutes until potato is tender.
Serve over rice.

name: Beef & Mushroom Rice Bowl
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet with onion, drain fat.
In separate pan, sauté mushrooms in butter until golden.
Combine beef, mushrooms, and soy sauce.
Serve over brown rice.

name: Garlic Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions.
Melt butter in a skillet, sauté garlic 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side.
Squeeze lemon over shrimp, toss with drained pasta.
Season with salt, pepper, and parsley if desired.

name: BBQ Chicken Baked Potato
instructions: Bake potato at 400°F for 40 minutes until tender.
Cook and shred chicken breast.
Mix ketchup and honey for a quick BBQ sauce, toss with chicken.
Split potato, stuff with BBQ chicken, and top with cheese.

name: Pinto Bean & Rice Burrito Bowl
instructions: Warm beans and corn together in a pot.
Season with salt, pepper, and cumin.
Serve over rice with salsa, sour cream, and cilantro.

name: Crispy Tofu Noodle Bowl
instructions: Press and cube tofu. Fry in oil over high heat until crispy on all sides.
Cook ramen noodles, discard seasoning packet.
Toss noodles with shredded cabbage, soy sauce, and crispy tofu.
Top with sliced green onion.

name: Chicken & Corn Chowder
instructions: Sauté onion and diced chicken in a pot until chicken is cooked.
Add potato cubes and broth, simmer 12 minutes.
Add corn and milk, cook 5 more minutes.
Mash some potato against the side of the pot to thicken.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Baked Ziti with Turkey & Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook pasta and drain.
Brown turkey in a skillet, add tomato sauce and Italian seasoning.
Mix pasta with sauce, pour into a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake 15-20 minutes until bubbly.

name: Beef Fajitas
instructions: Cook beef in a hot skillet, breaking apart, 5 minutes.
Add sliced peppers and onion, cook 4-5 minutes.
Squeeze lime over everything.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

name: Quinoa & Black Bean Power Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions.
Warm black beans and corn together.
Serve quinoa topped with beans, corn, sliced avocado, and cilantro.
Squeeze lime over the bowl.

name: Sausage & Egg Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add crumbled sausage and brown 4-5 minutes, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add diced bell pepper and cook another 2-3 minutes until softened and the sausage edges are crispy.
Reduce heat to medium. Push sausage mix to one side and pour in beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs gently, then fold everything together once the eggs are nearly set.
Top with shredded cheddar, cover for 30 seconds to melt, and serve hot.

name: Banana French Toast
instructions: Mash the banana in a shallow bowl, then whisk in the egg and milk until smooth.
Soak each slice of bread in the batter for about 20 seconds per side so it absorbs without falling apart.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook the soaked slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown and set in the middle.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

name: Veggie Frittata with Caramelized Onion
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-low. Add sliced onion and cook slowly for 10-12 minutes, stirring often, until deeply golden and sweet.
Raise heat to medium and add mushrooms. Cook 4-5 minutes until they release their moisture and brown.
Add the squeezed-dry spinach and stir for 1 minute.
Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper. Pour over the vegetables and tilt the pan to spread evenly.
Sprinkle mozzarella on top and let the bottom set for 2 minutes on the stovetop.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake 10-12 minutes until the center is just set and the top is lightly golden.
Let rest 3 minutes, then slice into wedges.

name: Shakshuka with Toasted Bread
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Add diced onion and bell pepper, cooking 5 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and paprika and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer 6-8 minutes until thickened to a rich sauce.
Use a spoon to make two wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook 4-6 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Toast the bread while the eggs finish.
Spoon the shakshuka into a bowl and serve with toasted bread for dipping.

name: From-Scratch Buttermilk Pancakes
instructions: Stir vinegar into the milk and let it sit 3 minutes to thicken into a buttermilk substitute.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 tsp baking soda (or 1 tsp baking powder).
In another bowl, whisk the soured milk with the egg and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry. Stir just until combined — small lumps are fine; do not overmix or pancakes will be tough.
Let the batter rest 5 minutes while you heat a skillet over medium with a thin layer of butter.
Ladle 1/4-cup portions into the pan. Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look dry, about 2 minutes.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stack and drizzle with honey.

name: Cheesy Black Bean Quesadilla with Sautéed Peppers
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium. Add onion and bell pepper, sauté 5 minutes until softened and slightly charred.
Stir in cumin and the drained black beans, mashing about half with the back of a spoon. Season and remove from pan.
Wipe the skillet, return to medium. Lay one tortilla in the pan.
Spread the bean-pepper mix over the tortilla and top with cheese. Cover with the second tortilla.
Cook 2-3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until each side is golden and the cheese is fully melted.
Let rest 1 minute, then cut into wedges.

name: Pan-Seared Salmon Salad with Lemon
instructions: Pat the salmon dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat 1/2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side down (or presentation side down) and cook undisturbed for 4 minutes to develop a crust.
Flip and cook another 3-4 minutes until just cooked through. Rest on a plate.
Whisk remaining oil with lemon juice, lemon zest, mustard, and a pinch of salt to make a quick vinaigrette.
Toss lettuce, cucumber, and tomato with the vinaigrette.
Flake the salmon over the salad and finish with extra lemon zest.

name: Lentil & Sweet Potato Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium. Sauté diced onion 4-5 minutes until translucent.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toast cumin and paprika in the oil for 20 seconds — this blooms the spices for deeper flavor.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and cook 2 minutes to break them down.
Add rinsed lentils, diced sweet potato, and broth. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 18-22 minutes until lentils are tender and sweet potato is fork-soft.
Uncover for the last 5 minutes if you want a thicker curry.
Taste and adjust salt. Top with chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup with Crispy Strips
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pot over medium. Add diced onion, cook 4 minutes.
Stir in garlic, cumin, and chili powder. Toast 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and stir to coat the aromatics.
Pour in broth and bring to a simmer. Add whole chicken breast and poach 12-14 minutes until fully cooked.
While chicken cooks, heat remaining oil in a small skillet over medium-high. Fry tortilla strips 2-3 minutes until crisp and golden; drain on paper towel and salt immediately.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to the pot.
Stir in lime juice. Taste and adjust salt.
Ladle into bowls, top with crispy strips and fresh cilantro.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef & Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook rice according to package directions and set aside.
Bring a small pot of salted water to a boil. Par-boil pepper halves for 3 minutes to soften, then drain upside-down.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sauté diced onion 3 minutes, then add ground beef.
Brown the beef 5-6 minutes, breaking it up; drain excess fat if needed.
Stir in garlic and Italian seasoning, then add 1/2 cup tomato sauce and the cooked rice. Simmer 2 minutes to combine.
Spoon the filling into the pepper halves and arrange in a baking dish.
Top each with remaining sauce and a generous pinch of mozzarella.
Bake 18-22 minutes until peppers are tender and cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage with Peppers & Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss cubed potato with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 12 minutes alone (potatoes need a head start).
Toss sausage coins, bell pepper, and onion wedges with remaining oil and Italian seasoning.
Pull the pan, push potatoes to one side, and spread the sausage and vegetables in a single layer.
Roast another 15-18 minutes, stirring once halfway, until sausage is browned and vegetables are tender with crisp edges.
Serve straight from the pan.

name: Cheesy Beef & Bean Skillet
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add diced onion and cook 2 minutes.
Add ground beef and brown 5-6 minutes, breaking it up. Stir in minced garlic in the last 30 seconds.
Drain excess fat. Stir in taco seasoning and let it toast for 30 seconds.
Add canned tomatoes and beans. Simmer 5-6 minutes until thickened.
Sprinkle cheese evenly across the top. Cover for 2 minutes to melt.
Serve straight from the skillet with tortillas or rice.

name: Braised Chicken Thighs with Mushroom Gravy
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven or heavy skillet over medium-high. Sear thighs skin-side down for 6-7 minutes until deeply golden. Flip and sear 3 more minutes. Remove to a plate.
Start the rice in a separate pot now (it will be ready when the chicken is done).
Pour off all but 1 tbsp fat from the pan. Add sliced mushrooms and cook 5 minutes until they release their water and brown.
Add diced onion and cook 3 minutes; stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir for 1 minute to cook the raw taste out.
Slowly whisk in broth, scraping up the browned bits at the bottom of the pan.
Return chicken to the pan, skin-side up. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and reduce heat to low. Braise 18-22 minutes until chicken is tender and gravy has thickened.
Stir butter into the gravy off the heat for a glossy finish.
Serve thighs over rice with the gravy spooned generously on top.

name: Soy-Ginger Marinated Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: In a bowl, whisk soy sauce, grated ginger, minced garlic, and honey. Add the beef and toss to coat. Marinate at least 15 minutes (or up to overnight in the fridge).
Start the rice now so it finishes with the stir-fry.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until shimmering — high heat is what gives stir-fry its character.
Lift beef out of the marinade (reserve the marinade) and add to the hot pan in a single layer. Sear undisturbed for 1 minute, then stir-fry 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove to a plate.
Add bell pepper and broccoli to the pan and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender with charred edges.
Add sliced onion and cook 1 minute more.
Return beef to the pan, pour in the reserved marinade plus 2 tbsp water, and toss for 1 minute until the sauce thickens and glazes everything.
Serve over rice, scattered with green onion.

name: Lentil Bolognese over Pasta
instructions: Heat oil in a wide skillet over medium. Add finely diced onion, carrot, and celery (a classic soffritto). Cook 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until soft and starting to caramelize at the edges.
Stir in minced garlic and Italian seasoning; cook 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes and stir to coat the soffritto. Simmer 2 minutes for the tomato to deepen in color.
Add rinsed lentils and broth. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 22-25 minutes until lentils are tender and the sauce is thick. Stir occasionally and add a splash of water if it gets too dry.
Meanwhile, cook pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Toss the drained pasta into the sauce with a splash of pasta water. Stir over low heat for 1-2 minutes so the noodles absorb the sauce.
Plate and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: From-Scratch Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Pound chicken cutlets to even thickness and season both sides with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.
Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken 4-5 minutes per side until deeply golden and just cooked through. Rest on a cutting board.
Drop the pasta into the boiling water and cook 1 minute less than the package says — it will finish in the sauce.
Reduce skillet heat to medium. Melt butter in the same pan and add minced garlic; cook 45 seconds until fragrant, not browned.
Sprinkle flour over the butter and whisk constantly for 1 full minute to cook out the raw flour taste — this is the roux.
Slowly stream in the warmed milk while whisking nonstop. Keep whisking until the sauce smooths out and starts to thicken, about 3-4 minutes.
Whisk in cream cheese until fully melted, then add mozzarella a handful at a time, stirring until silky. Season with salt and plenty of black pepper.
Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain the pasta and add it directly to the sauce. Toss to coat, loosening with pasta water as needed for a glossy texture.
Slice the rested chicken, fan it over the pasta, and finish with cracked pepper.

name: Sheet Pan Honey-Mustard Chicken & Veggies
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a sheet pan with parchment for easy cleanup.
Whisk honey, mustard, 1 tbsp oil, and minced garlic in a small bowl to make the glaze.
Toss cubed sweet potato with remaining oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on the sheet pan and roast 12 minutes (sweet potatoes need a head start).
Coat the chicken thighs in half the honey-mustard glaze.
Pull the pan, push potatoes to one side, and lay the chicken thighs in the open space. Roast 14 minutes.
Toss broccoli with a splash of oil and pile it onto the pan. Brush the remaining glaze over the chicken.
Roast another 8-10 minutes until chicken reads 165°F and broccoli edges are charred.
Let rest 3 minutes before serving.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajita Bowls
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Start the rice in a small pot.
On a large sheet pan, toss sliced chicken, bell peppers, and onion with olive oil and taco seasoning until evenly coated.
Spread everything in a single layer — crowding will steam instead of char.
Roast 15-18 minutes, stirring once halfway, until chicken is cooked through (165°F) and the vegetable edges are blackened and caramelized.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the hot pan and toss.
Build bowls with rice on the bottom, fajita mix on top, and warmed tortillas on the side. Spoon over any pan juices.

name: Sheet Pan Lemon-Garlic Salmon with Green Beans & Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Cut potatoes small (about 1/2-inch) so they cook in the same time as everything else. Toss with 1.5 tbsp oil, smashed garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread potatoes on a sheet pan and roast 18 minutes — they need the head start.
Meanwhile, toss green beans with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt.
Pat salmon dry, season with salt, pepper, and paprika. Drizzle with remaining oil and lay lemon slices on top.
After 18 minutes, pull the pan. Push potatoes to one side, add green beans next to them, and place salmon on the third part of the pan.
Dot small cubes of butter over the salmon and green beans.
Return to the oven and roast 10-12 more minutes — salmon should flake easily and green beans should be tender-crisp.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything at the table.

name: Crock Pot Salsa Chicken Tacos
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the slow cooker. Pour salsa over the top and sprinkle with taco seasoning.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours, or HIGH for 3-4 hours.
In the last 30 minutes, stir in the drained black beans and corn so they warm through.
Lift the chicken out, shred with two forks, and stir back into the salsa-bean mixture.
Warm tortillas and load with shredded chicken. Top with cheese and any extras you like.

name: Crock Pot Chicken & Vegetable Soup
instructions: Dice onion, mince garlic, slice carrots and celery, and cube the potatoes. Pile everything into the slow cooker.
Lay the whole chicken breasts on top of the vegetables.
Pour in broth, then sprinkle Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper across the top.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6-7 hours or HIGH for 3-4 hours, until chicken is fully cooked and vegetables are tender.
Stir in the frozen mixed vegetables and let them heat through, about 10 minutes.
Pull the chicken out, shred with two forks, and stir back into the broth.
Taste and adjust salt. Ladle into bowls.

name: Crock Pot BBQ Pulled Chicken

ingredients.measure: 4 buns or thick slices, to serve

instructions: In a bowl, whisk together ketchup, honey, vinegar, mustard, paprika, chili powder, minced garlic, and 1/2 tsp salt — this is your homemade BBQ sauce.
Scatter diced onion across the bottom of the slow cooker.
Lay chicken thighs on top and pour the sauce over the chicken, turning each piece to coat.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5-6 hours or HIGH for 3 hours, until the chicken is fork-tender.
Lift chicken onto a cutting board and shred with two forks. Return shredded meat to the sauce and stir.
If the sauce feels thin, leave the lid off for 15 minutes on HIGH to reduce.
Pile onto buns or thick toasted bread. Pickle slices on top are great here.

name: Crock Pot Lentil & Sweet Potato Stew
instructions: Rinse lentils well in a strainer until the water runs clear.
Dice onion, mince garlic, cube sweet potatoes, and slice carrots and celery. Add all to the slow cooker.
Pour in the rinsed lentils, crushed tomatoes, and broth. Stir in cumin, paprika, olive oil, and 1 tsp salt.
Cover and cook on LOW for 7-8 hours or HIGH for 3.5-4 hours, until lentils and sweet potatoes are tender.
Mash a few cubes of sweet potato against the side of the cooker to thicken the broth.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot — even better the next day.

name: Crock Pot Beef & Bean Chili
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add diced onion and bell pepper, cooking 4 minutes.
Add ground beef and brown 6-7 minutes, breaking it up. Browning here is what gives the chili its deep flavor — do not skip.
Stir in minced garlic, chili powder, cumin, and paprika. Toast 45 seconds until fragrant.
Transfer the entire skillet contents — fat and all — into the slow cooker.
Add drained beans, crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Stir to combine.
Cover and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or HIGH for 3-4 hours. The longer, the better the flavor.
Taste before serving and adjust salt. If too thin, leave the lid off and cook on HIGH for 20 minutes to reduce.
Ladle into bowls, top with shredded cheddar, and serve.

name: Cheesy Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cube and boil potatoes 15 min until fork-tender.
In a skillet, brown ground beef with diced onion and garlic, 8 min.
Add frozen mixed veg and broth, simmer 5 min, season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a baking dish.
Drain potatoes and mash with butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Spread mash over the beef. Top with shredded cheddar.
Bake 20 min until bubbly and golden on top.

name: Stovetop Mac & Cheese with Broccoli
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water 8 min. Add frozen broccoli during the last 3 min.
Drain and set aside.
Melt butter in the same pot, whisk in flour for 1 min.
Slowly whisk in milk, cook 2-3 min until thickened.
Off heat, stir in cheddar until smooth. Season.
Fold pasta and broccoli into the cheese sauce.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, ginger, and minced garlic.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken 6-8 min until golden.
Pour in sauce, reduce 2-3 min until glossy.
Steam or microwave broccoli 3 min.
Serve chicken and broccoli over rice. Drizzle sesame oil and top with green onion.

name: Ginger Garlic Shrimp Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook rice per package.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry bell pepper and carrots 2 min.
Add ginger and garlic, 30 sec.
Push veg aside, add shrimp, cook 2-3 min per side until pink.
Pour soy sauce in, toss 1 min.
Off heat, drizzle sesame oil and top with green onion. Serve over rice.

name: Slow Pork Carnitas Tacos

ingredients.measure: 1 1/2 lb pork shoulder or chops, cubed

instructions: Toss pork with cumin, salt, garlic, lime juice, and orange juice.
Place in a heavy pot with diced onion and 1/2 cup water. Cover and simmer on LOW 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Uncover and crank to medium-high. Cook 10 min to crisp the edges.
Shred with two forks.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet 30 sec each side.
Pile carnitas on tortillas, top with cilantro, salsa, and lime wedges.

name: Black Bean & Corn Quesadilla
instructions: In a bowl, mash beans lightly with cumin and salsa.
Spread the bean mix on 2 tortillas. Top with corn and cheddar. Cover with the other tortillas.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium. Cook each quesadilla 3 min per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with extra salsa.

name: Shrimp Aglio e Olio
instructions: Boil pasta in heavily salted water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil over medium-low. Add sliced garlic, cook 2-3 min until pale gold — do not brown.
Add shrimp, cook 2 min per side.
Add drained pasta, 1/2 cup pasta water, lemon juice, italian seasoning. Toss vigorously 1 min to emulsify.
Off heat, stir in parmesan. Season. Add more pasta water if dry.

name: Caprese Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Drain and rinse with cold water.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, garlic, italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Toss pasta with tomatoes, mozzarella, and dressing.
Chill 15 min before serving for best flavor.

name: BBQ Chicken Thighs with Corn
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss potato wedges with olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan.
Pat chicken dry, season with salt and pepper. Place skin-side up on the same pan.
Roast 25 min, then brush chicken generously with BBQ sauce.
Return to oven for 5-7 more min until sauce caramelizes.
Warm corn on the stove with a pat of butter.

name: Pulled Pork BBQ Sandwiches with Slaw

ingredients.measure: 1 1/2 lb pork shoulder or chops, cubed

instructions: Place pork in a heavy pot with 1/2 cup water and a pinch of salt. Cover and simmer on LOW 2 hours until fork-tender.
Shred with forks. Discard most of the cooking liquid. Toss pork with BBQ sauce.
Whisk mayo, vinegar, sugar, and salt. Toss with cabbage and carrots.
Pile pork on toasted buns. Top with slaw.

name: Greek Chicken Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa per package directions.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Toss half with cubed chicken.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet 5-6 min until cooked through.
Divide quinoa into bowls. Top with chicken, cucumber, tomato, and feta.
Drizzle remaining dressing over the top.

name: Chickpea & Feta Pita Pocket
instructions: Lightly mash chickpeas in a bowl, leaving texture.
Add cucumber, tomato, feta, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt. Stir.
Warm pitas 30 sec, slice open.
Stuff with lettuce and chickpea mix.

name: Roasted Veggie Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss sweet potato, zucchini, bell pepper, and chickpeas with 2 tbsp olive oil, paprika, cumin, garlic, and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan 25-30 min, tossing once.
Cook quinoa per package.
Divide quinoa into bowls, top with roasted veg.
Whisk lemon juice with remaining olive oil and drizzle over.

name: Garden Veggie Scramble
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Sauté mushrooms and bell pepper 4 min.
Add spinach (thawed if frozen) and tomato, cook 1 min.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour in.
Stir gently with a spatula, drawing curds across the pan, 2-3 min until just set.
Off heat, fold in cheddar.

name: Salmon Avocado Power Salad
instructions: Pat salmon dry, season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 min, flip and cook 3 min more.
Whisk remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and mustard.
Plate greens, cucumber, and avocado. Flake salmon on top.
Drizzle dressing and finish with pepper.

name: Bacon, Egg & Spinach Keto Skillet
instructions: Cook bacon in a cold skillet over medium, 6-8 min until crisp. Drain on paper towel, leave 1 tbsp fat in pan.
Add spinach (thawed) to the fat, cook 1 min until warmed through.
Crack eggs into the spinach. Cook to your liking, 3-4 min.
Top with crumbled bacon and cheddar, season.
Serve with avocado slices.

name: Huevos Rancheros
instructions: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet 30 sec per side. Set aside.
Warm beans with cumin and a splash of water in the skillet, 2 min.
Heat olive oil, fry eggs sunny-side up 3-4 min.
Layer tortillas with beans, then eggs.
Top with salsa, cheese, and cilantro.

name: Breakfast Quesadilla
instructions: Sauté bell pepper in butter 2 min.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour in. Scramble soft, 2 min.
Place one tortilla in the pan, top with eggs and cheese, cover with the second tortilla.
Cook 2 min per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges. Serve with salsa.

name: Veggie Tofu Scramble
instructions: Heat olive oil over medium. Sauté onion and bell pepper 3 min.
Add garlic, paprika, and cumin, 30 sec.
Crumble in tofu, breaking up with a spatula. Cook 5 min until heated and slightly golden.
Stir in thawed spinach, cook 1 min.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Cinnamon Apple Baked Oatmeal
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease an 8x8 baking dish.
Whisk milk, egg, melted butter, honey, salt, and 1 tsp cinnamon if you have it.
Stir in oats and half the diced apple.
Pour into dish. Scatter remaining apple on top.
Bake 28-32 min until set and lightly golden.
Cut into squares. Keeps 4 days refrigerated.

name: Green Power Smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass. Drink cold.

name: Mediterranean Breakfast Plate
instructions: Place eggs in a small pot, cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, cover, off heat, let sit 10 min. Cool in ice water, peel, halve.
Toast bread or warm pita.
On a plate, arrange eggs, feta, cucumber slices, and tomato slices.
Drizzle olive oil over everything. Squeeze lemon. Season.

name: Savory Rice & Soft Egg Bowl
instructions: Warm rice in a bowl with butter and a pinch of salt.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium. Fry eggs sunny-side up with crispy edges, 3 min.
Slide eggs onto the rice.
Drizzle soy sauce and sesame oil over the eggs.
Top with green onion. Break the yolks before eating.

name: Egg in a Hole
instructions: Use a glass or cookie cutter to punch a 2-inch hole in the center of each bread slice.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium.
Lay bread in pan. Crack an egg into each hole.
Cook 2-3 min until bottom is golden, flip carefully, cook 1 min more for runny yolks.
Season and serve, including the toasted bread rounds.

name: Italian Caprese Breakfast Toast
instructions: Toast bread, then rub the cut side of the garlic clove across the warm slices.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Layer tomato slices, sprinkle with salt, then top with mozzarella.
Broil 2 min until cheese bubbles.
Sprinkle italian seasoning. Optional: top with a fried egg.

name: Loaded Cheesy Hash Brown Skillet
instructions: Shred potatoes, squeeze out moisture in a towel.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high. Add onion and bell pepper, 2 min.
Spread potatoes evenly in pan. Press down. Cook undisturbed 6-7 min until golden underneath.
Flip in sections, cook another 5 min.
Sprinkle cheese over the top. Make 2 wells, crack in eggs.
Cover, cook 3-4 min until eggs set and cheese melts.
Top with green onion.

name: Sheet Pan Breakfast Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan.
Toss potatoes with olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Roast 20 min.
Move potatoes to one side, add bacon and bell pepper. Roast 8 min.
Make 4 wells in the veggies. Crack eggs into each.
Return to oven 5-7 min until whites set and yolks are still soft.

name: Quinoa Breakfast Bowl with Banana & PB
instructions: Rinse quinoa. Simmer with milk, salt, and 1/2 cup water 15 min until liquid absorbs.
Stir in peanut butter and honey.
Top with sliced banana. Serve warm.

name: Crispy Tortilla Migas
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet. Fry tortilla strips 2-3 min until crisp. Drain on paper towel, leaving 1 tbsp oil in pan.
Add jalapeño, sauté 30 sec.
Whisk eggs with salt, pour in. Scramble soft 2 min.
Return tortilla strips to pan, stir in salsa.
Top with cheddar and cilantro.

name: Cinnamon French Toast Sticks

ingredients.measure: 1 tbsp + 1 tsp cinnamon if you have it

instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, and sugar in a shallow dish.
Cut bread into thick sticks.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium.
Dip each stick in the egg mix, let drip, then pan-fry 2 min per side until golden.
Drizzle with honey.

name: Spinach & Feta Egg Wrap
instructions: Squeeze excess water from thawed spinach.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Add spinach, cook 1 min.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour in. Scramble soft 2 min.
Stir in feta.
Warm tortilla. Pile in eggs, roll into a wrap.

name: Yogurt Granola Crunch Bowl
instructions: Toast oats in butter in a small skillet 3-4 min until golden. Drizzle in 1 tbsp honey, stir, cook 30 sec to crisp. Cool 2 min.
Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Top with the granola, diced apple, peanut butter, and a drizzle of honey.

name: Sheet Pan Pancake Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Butter a sheet pan or 9x13 dish.
Whisk flour, sugar, salt, and 2 tsp baking powder if you have it.
In another bowl whisk milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry — just until mixed. Pour into pan, smooth.
Scatter banana slices on top.
Bake 12-15 min until set and golden.
Cut into squares. Drizzle with honey.

name: Mushroom & Spinach Strata
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter a 9x9 baking dish.
Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter 6 min until soft. Add garlic, 30 sec. Stir in squeezed spinach.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Layer bread cubes, veg, and half the cheese in the dish. Pour egg mix over evenly. Press down. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake 35-40 min until set and golden.

name: Apple Sausage Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Brown sausage in a skillet over medium-high 6 min, crumbling. Remove.
Melt butter in the same pan. Add sweet potato, cover and cook 8 min, stirring.
Add onion and apple, cook 4 min more until tender.
Return sausage. Season with paprika, salt, pepper. Toss 1 min.

name: Veggie Breakfast Pizza on Tortilla
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place tortillas on a sheet pan, brush with olive oil.
Bake 3 min to crisp slightly.
Soft-scramble eggs in a pan, 2 min.
Top tortillas with eggs, tomato, pepper, mozzarella, and italian seasoning.
Bake 6-8 min until cheese bubbles and edges crisp.
Slice into wedges.

name: Classic Cobb Salad
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Sear in a hot skillet 4 min per side. Rest, then dice.
Hard-boil eggs: cover with cold water, bring to a boil, off heat, cover, 10 min. Peel.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Arrange lettuce on a platter. Top with rows of chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomato, and cheese.
Drizzle with dressing right before serving.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wrap with Ranch
instructions: Melt butter with hot sauce in a pan over low heat. Toss shredded chicken to coat.
Mix ranch seasoning with sour cream.
Spread ranch on each tortilla. Layer with lettuce, buffalo chicken, and cheddar.
Roll tightly. Slice in half.

name: Cold Sesame Peanut Noodles
instructions: Cook noodles, drain, and rinse with cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey, vinegar, ginger, and 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss noodles with sauce.
Top with carrots, cucumber, and green onion.
Serve cold or room temp.

name: Spicy Tuna Poke-Style Bowl
instructions: Mix mayo, soy sauce, hot sauce, and sesame oil.
Toss drained tuna with half the sauce.
Divide rice between bowls. Top with tuna, avocado, and cucumber.
Drizzle remaining sauce. Top with green onion.

name: Italian Sub Sandwich
instructions: Slice rolls open. Spread mayo on one side.
Layer turkey, mozzarella, lettuce, and tomato.
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, italian seasoning, and salt.
Drizzle the dressing over the fillings. Close and press lightly.

name: Loaded Baked Sweet Potato Lunch
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Prick sweet potatoes all over. Bake on a sheet pan 40-45 min until soft.
Warm beans with cumin and salt.
Split sweet potatoes open with a fork.
Stuff with beans, salsa, cheese.
Top with sour cream and cilantro.

name: Greek Salad with Chickpeas
instructions: Toss chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, bell pepper, onion, and lettuce.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss salad with dressing.
Top with feta. Let sit 5 min before serving.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a pot. Sauté onion and garlic 4 min. Add carrots, 2 min.
Whisk in flour, cook 1 min.
Slowly whisk in broth and milk. Simmer 5 min until thickened.
Add broccoli, cook 8 min until tender.
Off heat, whisk in cheese until smooth. Season.

name: Bánh Mì-Style Pork Sandwich
instructions: Quick-pickle carrots and cucumber in vinegar, sugar, and pinch of salt. Set aside 15 min.
Marinate pork in soy sauce, honey, and minced garlic 10 min.
Sear pork in a hot skillet 2-3 min per side.
Spread mayo on bread. Layer pork, pickles, cilantro, and jalapeño.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
instructions: Whisk mayo, lemon juice, mustard, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper for caesar dressing.
Toss romaine with dressing and half the parmesan.
Pile chicken and dressed lettuce in tortilla. Top with remaining parmesan.
Roll tight. Cut diagonally.

name: Beef Stroganoff over Egg Noodles

ingredients.measure: 8 oz egg noodles or wide pasta

instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain.
Brown beef in a skillet 6 min, breaking up. Remove.
Melt butter in the same pan. Sauté onion 4 min, mushrooms 5 min, garlic 30 sec.
Sprinkle flour, cook 1 min. Whisk in broth, simmer 4 min until thickened.
Off heat, stir in sour cream and mustard. Return beef.
Toss with noodles. Season.

name: Crispy Chicken Parmesan over Spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Boil pasta until al dente.
Pound chicken to 1/2 inch. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up dredge: flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with italian seasoning and half the parmesan.
Coat each chicken piece through all three.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet. Sear chicken 3 min per side until golden.
Spoon marinara over chicken. Top with mozzarella and remaining parmesan.
Bake 12 min until cheese melts and chicken is cooked through.
Serve over spaghetti tossed with remaining sauce.

name: Black Bean Burgers with Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Bake 25-30 min, flipping.
Mash beans coarsely with a fork. Mix with breadcrumbs, beaten egg, diced onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Form 4 patties.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium. Cook patties 4 min per side until crisp.
Serve on buns with lettuce, tomato, and avocado. Fries on the side.

name: Korean-Style Bulgogi Beef Bowl
instructions: Cook rice per package.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, ginger, and minced garlic.
Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over high. Brown beef 5 min.
Pour in sauce, simmer 3 min until glossy.
Plate rice. Top with beef, carrots, and cucumber.
Finish with green onion and a drizzle of hot sauce.

name: Italian Sausage & Peppers over Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente.
Heat olive oil in a deep skillet. Brown sausage 6 min, breaking up. Remove.
Sauté onion and peppers in the drippings 8 min.
Add garlic, 30 sec. Pour in tomatoes, italian seasoning, and salt.
Return sausage, simmer 10 min.
Toss with drained pasta. Finish with parmesan.

name: Mongolian Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook rice.
Whisk soy sauce, sugar, ginger, garlic, and 1/2 cup water.
Toss beef with flour.
Heat oil in a wok over high. Sear beef 4 min until edges crisp. Remove.
Stir-fry broccoli 3 min.
Return beef, pour in sauce. Simmer 2 min until glossy.
Toss in green onion at the end.
Serve over rice.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Boil lasagna noodles 2 min less than package time.
Sauté onion in olive oil 4 min. Add zucchini and mushrooms, cook 8 min. Add garlic, 30 sec. Stir in spinach.
Mix cottage cheese, egg, half the parmesan, italian seasoning, and salt.
In a 9x13 dish: thin layer sauce, then noodles, half the cottage cheese, half the veg, 1/3 mozzarella. Repeat. Top with noodles, remaining sauce, mozzarella, parmesan.
Cover with foil. Bake 30 min. Uncover, bake 15 min more until bubbly.
Rest 10 min before cutting.

name: One-Pan Greek Lemon Chicken with Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss potatoes and chicken with the marinade in a large baking dish.
Arrange chicken skin-side up. Tuck lemon slices around. Pour broth into the dish.
Roast 45-50 min until chicken is 165°F and potatoes are tender.
Scatter feta on top before serving.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Cook rice halfway, 8 min, drain.
Core cabbage. Boil whole head 5-7 min until outer leaves peel off easily. Remove 12-14 leaves. Trim thick rib.
Mix beef, partially-cooked rice, diced onion, egg, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place a heaping spoonful of filling on each leaf. Fold sides in, roll up.
Spread some crushed tomato in a baking dish. Arrange rolls seam-down.
Mix remaining tomatoes, tomato sauce, and garlic. Pour over rolls.
Cover with foil. Bake 75 min.

name: Tuna Noodle Casserole

ingredients.measure: 1 can cream of mushroom or chicken

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Butter a 9x13 dish.
Boil pasta 2 min less than package time. Drain.
Mix soup with milk in a large bowl. Stir in onion, peas, tuna, half the cheese, pasta, salt, and pepper.
Pour into baking dish. Top with remaining cheese.
Toss breadcrumbs with melted butter, sprinkle over.
Bake 25-30 min until bubbly and golden.

name: Tropical Mango Berry Smoothie
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend 60 seconds until smooth and pourable.
Pour into a tall glass. Serve cold.

name: Apple Pie Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add apple, oats, yogurt, milk, honey, and banana to a blender.
Add 1 tsp cinnamon if you have it.
Blend 60 sec until smooth.
Drink cold.

name: Orange Carrot Sunrise Smoothie
instructions: Add orange, carrot, banana, yogurt, ginger, honey, and 1/2 cup water or ice to a blender.
Blend on high 60-90 sec until completely smooth — carrots take longer than fruit.
Pour and serve.

name: Spinach Avocado Power Smoothie
instructions: Add spinach (thawed), avocado, banana, milk, peanut butter, and honey to a blender.
Blend 60 sec until smooth and creamy.
Serve immediately.

name: Berry Yogurt Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend frozen berries, yogurt, half the banana, milk, and honey until thick and scoopable — add milk a splash at a time only if needed.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, oats, and a drizzle of peanut butter.

name: Cottage Cheese & Fresh Fruit Bowl

ingredients.measure: 2 tbsp, toasted if you have time

instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with diced apple and banana.
Sprinkle oats over the top.
Drizzle honey and peanut butter.

name: Berry Almond Overnight Oats
instructions: In a jar, stir oats, milk, yogurt, honey, peanut butter, and a pinch of salt.
Add frozen berries on top (they thaw and color the oats overnight).
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Stir before eating. Add a splash of milk if too thick.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Add sweet potato, cover, cook 10-12 min until tender, stirring.
Add black beans and cumin, cook 2 min.
Push to the side. Fry eggs sunny-side up in the same pan, 3 min.
Plate sweet potato and beans, top with eggs, avocado, and salsa.
Season.

name: Zucchini Carrot Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a muffin tin with paper liners.
Whisk flour, salt, and 1 tsp baking powder (and 1 tsp cinnamon if you have it).
In another bowl, whisk eggs, milk, honey, and melted butter.
Squeeze excess moisture from shredded zucchini in a towel.
Fold wet into dry, then fold in zucchini and carrots — don't overmix.
Divide into 10-12 muffin cups, filling each 3/4 full.
Bake 22-25 min until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Garden Veggie & Egg Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Sauté bell pepper and zucchini 3 min.
Add spinach (thawed and squeezed) and tomato, cook 1 min.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour in. Scramble soft 2 min.
Warm tortilla 30 sec.
Pile eggs in the tortilla, top with cheddar, roll up tight.
Slice in half diagonally.
